tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtad hrul zangs gling pa'i 'dod gsol la dpal sa skyar dmigs bsal sbyar ba bzhugs so// skyabs gnas dam pa rnams dang khyad par sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i lha klu bdud btsan ma mo la sogs pa dregs byed ci mchis pa thams cad thugs ma yengs par dgongs shig rje btsun sa skya pa rnams nas gnas skabs kun tu mchod 'os gtsug tu khur/ skyong 'os spun zla ltar bskyangs/ byams 'os 'gro ba kun la brtse sems rgyun mi 'chad par bsgom kyang / rbod gtong byad ma 'khor bcas kyi 'dug tu mi ster ba 'dug go /sa skya pa 'khor bcas nas byad ma rnams la lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas phog 'gal du 'gro ba spu tsam byas min dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang / 'dir 'dus dregs byed 'khor bcas kyi zag bcas zag med mngon shes kyis dgongs shig gzigs shig byad ma rnams kyi lus kyi rdzas gsog lugs sam/ ngag gi sngags bzlas lugs sam/ sems kyi dmigs pa zhe ngan ci byas pa thams cad khyed rnams kyi mi mkhyen cing mi gzigs pa skad cig kyang med pas/ sa skya pa 'khor bcas bden pa bden thog tu thon la mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod cig gdug can byad ma rbad 'dre bcas la 'phral du tshar gcod rjes bzung ma mdzad na rang gzhan kun 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las thar dus med pa ma zad/ lha 'dre dregs pa can khyed rnams kyang nyes med sems can gyi srog dbugs la rngams pa las/ gdug pa can 'di dag myur du zos na za ba'i za go dang btung ba'i btung go chod par 'dug pas byad ma 'khor bcas kyi lus srog longs spyod thams cad khyed rnams kyi zhal du btab bo/ /gang bcol 'phrin las thams cad myur du sgrubs shig rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha lha srin sde brgyad yul lha gzhi bdag 'go ba'i lha lnga 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang /

rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i༞ rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi༞ sa skya pa 'khor bcas kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi steng na nyes pa med pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ byad ma gdug pa can rnams nas rdzas sngags ting 'dzin rbad 'dre rbod gtong ngan g.yo 'phrul gsum ci dang ci bgyis pa thams cad lo zla zhag dang za ma ma 'gyangs par byad ma lha srung 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi steng du rang gshed rang la bzlog nas lus ngag yid gsum thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gyur cig raṃ yaṃ khaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gser skyems kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di nyid 'bul zhing mchod pa'i yul du gyur pa ni/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang / khyad par yul phyogs dang sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ /gsol lo/ /mchod do/ /mgron no/ /zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dis tshims zhing mnyes nas/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzad nas yid la brnag pa'i byad ma rbad 'dre 'khor bcas thal ba'i rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod cig rje btsun sa skya pa rnams la gzhan gyi mnan gtad phung shig sbyor ba ngan pa bshig cig de dag gi bsam sbyor gyi 'bras bu thams cad med par gyis shig klu gnyan dregs pa can khyed rnams dang rje btsun sa skya pa rnams 'khon med cing bsdum par byas pa yin no/ /khyed bdud du ma mdzad par lha dang dpal du mdzod la zhi ba dang bde legs su mdzod cig spu ta spu ta mnan 'dre ma hā kro ta ya/ hūm̐ pi ti ta ya hūm̐/ phu ma ni si ni a lo ga na te ho si ni sa kha'i na ga le na ga le a ge a ge na ga ra tsa na ga ra tsa/ tsi tsi dzi tsi/

'du she 'du she du pa ya du pa ya na ga ra tsa/ pha rol gyi rbod gtong mnan gtad bzlog bzlog/ //ces pa 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos sbyar zhing yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pa'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ gtad hrul zangs gling pa'i 'dod gsol la dpal sa skyar dmigs bsal sbyar ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
